reason: The count error is builder test design. The catalog documents the app-module case only (build-process.md, Platform-provided libraries) and does not say the integration-test module needs it too.
heading: Dependencies > Project Dependencies
proposed: Platform libraries that the app module declares with provided scope (for example PDFBox) are not on the integration-test class path, because provided dependencies are not passed on to other modules. A test that uses such a library fails with NoClassDefFoundError. Declare the same artifact in the integration-test module with provided scope as well. The generated integration-test pom has no dependency fragment, so keep the edit under generator-ignore control (see best-practices/backend/generator-ignore-config-protection.md).
